description: Child profile fields + the rules that let personalization ADD motivating out-of-level tokens without RAISING the reading difficulty of the surrounding text.

name_complexity.note: Set 'hard' for long/unusual names so layout gives space and no other new words share the page.

theme_favorite.note: e.g., a specific dinosaur; may be an out-of-level anchor word.

child_name.rationale: Most motivating word in the book; recognized very early; repeats. Treated as a personal proper-noun heart word regardless of decodability.

balancing_rule.statement: On any page containing an out-of-level personal or theme token, every OTHER word on that page must be fully at-level (decodable-by-level or a live heart word).
balancing_rule.purpose: Keeps the decodable reading load flat while the content feels custom.
